#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate UNICEF 'Every Child Deserves to Learn' advocacy poster."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math

# ── Dimensions (A1 portrait at 150 DPI) ──────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967

# ── Color Palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DEEP_NAVY    = (10, 32, 62)
UNICEF_CYAN  = (28, 171, 226)
CYAN_DARK    = (20, 130, 190)
MID_BLUE     = (14, 55, 100)
WARM_AMBER   = (245, 166, 35)
SOFT_ORANGE  = (255, 140, 66)
DEEP_AMBER   = (200, 120, 20)
WHITE        = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE    = (235, 245, 252)
LIGHT_CYAN   = (190, 230, 250)
CHARCOAL     = (40, 40, 50)
LIGHT_GRAY   = (210, 225, 240)
DARK_CARD    = (18, 52, 96)
DARKER_CARD  = (12, 38, 72)

# ── Fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_BOLD   = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_REG    = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf"
FONT_LIB_B  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_LIB_R  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf"

def make_font(path, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)

# ── Helper: vertical gradient ────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_vgradient(draw, bbox, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, (y1 - y0))
        r = int(color_top[0] + (color_bot[0] - color_top[0]) * t)
        g = int(color_top[1] + (color_bot[1] - color_top[1]) * t)
        b = int(color_top[2] + (color_bot[2] - color_top[2]) * t)
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=(r, g, b))

# ── Helper: centered text, returns text height ───────────────────────
def draw_centered(draw, text, y, font, fill, w=W):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    x = (w - tw) // 2
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)
    return bbox[3] - bbox[1]

# ── Helper: wrapped text, returns final y ────────────────────────────
def draw_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, font, fill, max_width, line_spacing=1.35):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = current + " " + word if current else word
        bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), test, font=font)
        if bbox[2] - bbox[0] <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    bbox_h = draw.textbbox((0, 0), "Ay", font=font)
    line_h = int((bbox_h[3] - bbox_h[1]) * line_spacing)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        draw.text((x, y + i * line_h), line, font=font, fill=fill)
    return y + len(lines) * line_h

# ── Helper: draw subtle dot pattern ──────────────────────────────────
def draw_dot_pattern(draw, bbox, spacing=40, dot_r=2, color=(255, 255, 255, 8)):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = bbox
    for y in range(y0, y1, spacing):
        for x in range(x0, x1, spacing):
            draw.ellipse([x - dot_r, y - dot_r, x + dot_r, y + dot_r], fill=color)

# ── Create image ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), DEEP_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: HERO — "250 MILLION" visual anchor
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
hero_h = 1400
draw_vgradient(draw, (0, 0, W, hero_h), DEEP_NAVY, MID_BLUE)

# Decorative translucent circles via RGBA overlay
overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, hero_h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
odraw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
# Large circle top-right
odraw.ellipse([W - 700, -300, W + 300, 700], fill=(28, 171, 226, 22))
# Medium circle bottom-left
odraw.ellipse([-200, hero_h - 500, 400, hero_h + 100], fill=(245, 166, 35, 18))
# Small cyan accent
odraw.ellipse([W - 1200, hero_h - 300, W - 800, hero_h + 100], fill=(28, 171, 226, 15))
# Subtle diagonal lines
for i in range(8):
    x_off = W - 900 + i * 50
    odraw.line([(x_off, 50), (x_off - 400, 550)], fill=(255, 255, 255, 12), width=2)
# Dot pattern in center area
for y in range(100, hero_h - 100, 50):
    for x in range(100, W - 100, 50):
        dist = math.sqrt((x - W//2)**2 + (y - hero_h//2)**2)
        if dist > 800:
            odraw.ellipse([x-1, y-1, x+1, y+1], fill=(255, 255, 255, 6))

hero_bg = Image.alpha_composite(
    Image.new("RGBA", (W, hero_h), (0, 0, 0, 0)),
    overlay
)
img.paste(hero_bg.convert("RGB"), (0, 0))

# Redraw gradient as semi-transparent blend
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
draw_vgradient(draw, (0, 0, W, hero_h), DEEP_NAVY, MID_BLUE)

# Top amber bar
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 14], fill=WARM_AMBER)

# ── Campaign title ──
f_title = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 58)
draw_centered(draw, "EVERY CHILD DESERVES TO LEARN", 70, f_title, UNICEF_CYAN)

# Amber separator
draw.rectangle([W // 2 - 200, 148, W // 2 + 200, 154], fill=WARM_AMBER)

# ── THE BIG NUMBER: 250 MILLION ──
f_hero = make_font(FONT_LIB_B, 400)
draw_centered(draw, "250", 200, f_hero, WHITE)

f_million = make_font(FONT_LIB_B, 230)
draw_centered(draw, "MILLION", 630, f_million, WARM_AMBER)

# Subtitle
f_sub = make_font(FONT_REG, 54)
draw_centered(draw, "children are out of school worldwide", 910, f_sub, LIGHT_CYAN)

# Cyan accent line
draw.rectangle([W // 2 - 300, 1010, W // 2 + 300, 1015], fill=UNICEF_CYAN)

# One-liner
f_oneliner = make_font(FONT_REG, 36)
draw_centered(draw, "Millions of children are still denied their right to quality education.", 1060, f_oneliner, (170, 200, 225))

# Learning poverty highlight
f_lp = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 40)
draw_centered(draw, "70% of children cannot read a simple text by age 10", 1180, f_lp, WARM_AMBER)

# Thin amber line before stats section
draw.rectangle([0, hero_h - 8, W, hero_h], fill=WARM_AMBER)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: KEY STATISTICS — horizontal strip
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
stats_y = hero_h
stats_h = 400
draw.rectangle([0, stats_y, W, stats_y + stats_h], fill=OFF_WHITE)

# Section heading
f_stat_head = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 40)
draw_centered(draw, "THE GLOBAL EDUCATION CRISIS IN NUMBERS", stats_y + 20, f_stat_head, DEEP_NAVY)

f_stat_val = make_font(FONT_LIB_B, 68)
f_stat_lbl = make_font(FONT_REG, 26)

stats = [
    ("250M", "Children out\nof school"),
    ("70%", "Cannot read\nby age 10"),
    ("190+", "Countries with\nUNICEF programmes"),
    ("2.5x", "Girls more likely\nexcluded in crises"),
    ("~49%", "Children with disabilities\nout of school"),
]

col_w = W // len(stats)
val_y = stats_y + 80
for i, (val, label) in enumerate(stats):
    cx = col_w * i + col_w // 2
    if i > 0:
        draw.line([(col_w * i, stats_y + 65), (col_w * i, stats_y + stats_h - 30)],
                  fill=LIGHT_GRAY, width=2)
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), val, font=f_stat_val)
    vw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text((cx - vw // 2, val_y), val, font=f_stat_val, fill=DEEP_NAVY)
    lines = label.split("\n")
    for j, line in enumerate(lines):
        bbox_l = draw.textbbox((0, 0), line, font=f_stat_lbl)
        lw = bbox_l[2] - bbox_l[0]
        draw.text((cx - lw // 2, val_y + 90 + j * 36), line, font=f_stat_lbl, fill=CHARCOAL)

# Cyan bottom border
draw.rectangle([0, stats_y + stats_h - 6, W, stats_y + stats_h], fill=UNICEF_CYAN)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3: BARRIERS TO EDUCATION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
barriers_y = stats_y + stats_h
barriers_h = 1350
draw_vgradient(draw, (0, barriers_y, W, barriers_y + barriers_h), MID_BLUE, DEEP_NAVY)

# Subtle pattern overlay for this section
overlay2 = Image.new("RGBA", (W, barriers_h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
odraw2 = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay2)
for y in range(0, barriers_h, 60):
    for x in range(0, W, 60):
        if (x // 60 + y // 60) % 3 == 0:
            odraw2.ellipse([x-1, y-1, x+1, y+1], fill=(255, 255, 255, 8))
barriers_bg = Image.alpha_composite(
    Image.new("RGBA", (W, barriers_h), (0, 0, 0, 0)),
    overlay2
)
# Paste pattern over gradient
region = img.crop((0, barriers_y, W, barriers_y + barriers_h))
blended = Image.alpha_composite(region.convert("RGBA"), barriers_bg)
img.paste(blended.convert("RGB"), (0, barriers_y))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Section title
f_section = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 58)
draw_centered(draw, "BARRIERS TO EDUCATION", barriers_y + 55, f_section, WHITE)
draw.rectangle([W // 2 - 180, barriers_y + 130, W // 2 + 180, barriers_y + 137], fill=WARM_AMBER)

barriers = [
    ("CONFLICT", "Armed Conflict & Emergencies",
     "Schools destroyed, teachers displaced, children traumatized. Girls are 2.5x more likely to be out of school in crisis regions."),
    ("POVERTY", "Poverty",
     "Families cannot afford fees, uniforms, or supplies, and may rely on children for labour or income."),
    ("GENDER", "Gender Inequality",
     "Deeply rooted social norms limit girls' access to education, especially at the secondary level."),
    ("ABILITY", "Disability",
     "Nearly half of all children with disabilities in low-income countries never set foot in a classroom."),
    ("CLIMATE", "Climate Change",
     "Floods, droughts, and extreme weather increasingly disrupt schooling, hitting the most vulnerable hardest."),
]

f_btitle = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 40)
f_bdesc = make_font(FONT_REG, 30)
f_bbadge = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 22)

margin_x = 160
card_gap = 60
card_w = (W - margin_x * 2 - card_gap) // 2
card_h = 240

# Draw first 4 cards in 2x2 grid, then center the 5th
for i, (badge, title, desc) in enumerate(barriers):
    if i < 4:
        col = i % 2
        row = i // 2
        cx = margin_x + col * (card_w + card_gap)
        cy = barriers_y + 180 + row * (card_h + 35)
    else:
        # 5th card centered
        cx = (W - card_w) // 2
        cy = barriers_y + 180 + 2 * (card_h + 35)

    # Card background
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (cx, cy, cx + card_w, cy + card_h), radius=16,
        fill=DARK_CARD, outline=UNICEF_CYAN
    )

    # Amber badge top-left
    badge_w = len(badge) * 16 + 30
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (cx + 20, cy + 18, cx + 20 + badge_w, cy + 54), radius=8,
        fill=WARM_AMBER
    )
    bbox_b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), badge, font=f_bbadge)
    bw = bbox_b[2] - bbox_b[0]
    draw.text((cx + 20 + (badge_w - bw) // 2, cy + 22), badge,
              font=f_bbadge, fill=DEEP_NAVY)

    # Title
    draw.text((cx + 20, cy + 70), title, font=f_btitle, fill=WHITE)

    # Description
    draw_wrapped(draw, desc, cx + 20, cy + 125, f_bdesc, LIGHT_CYAN,
                 card_w - 50, line_spacing=1.4)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4: UNICEF FOCUS AREAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
focus_y = barriers_y + barriers_h
focus_h = 850
draw.rectangle([0, focus_y, W, focus_y + focus_h], fill=OFF_WHITE)

draw_centered(draw, "UNICEF'S EDUCATION FOCUS AREAS", focus_y + 45, f_section, DEEP_NAVY)
draw.rectangle([W // 2 - 220, focus_y + 120, W // 2 + 220, focus_y + 126], fill=WARM_AMBER)

focus_areas = [
    ("Early Childhood", "Building foundations through\npre-primary education"),
    ("Inclusive Education", "Ensuring children with disabilities\nand marginalized groups thrive"),
    ("Gender Equality", "Removing barriers that prevent\ngirls from completing school"),
    ("Education in Emergencies", "Learning continuity for children\naffected by conflict & disasters"),
    ("Digital Learning", "Leveraging technology to expand\naccess and improve quality"),
    ("Adolescent Skills", "Equipping young people with\nskills for employment & life"),
]

f_ftitle = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 32)
f_fdesc = make_font(FONT_REG, 25)
f_fnum = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 26)

cols = 3
rows = 2
cmargin = 110
cgap_x = 40
cgap_y = 35
fcard_w = (W - cmargin * 2 - cgap_x * (cols - 1)) // cols
fcard_h = 260

for i, (title, desc) in enumerate(focus_areas):
    col = i % cols
    row = i // cols
    fx = cmargin + col * (fcard_w + cgap_x)
    fy = focus_y + 155 + row * (fcard_h + cgap_y)

    # White card
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        (fx, fy, fx + fcard_w, fy + fcard_h), radius=12,
        fill=WHITE, outline=LIGHT_GRAY
    )
    # Cyan left accent bar
    draw.rectangle([fx + 1, fy + 15, fx + 9, fy + fcard_h - 15], fill=UNICEF_CYAN)

    # Number circle
    nr = 22
    ncx = fx + 45
    ncy = fy + 50
    draw.ellipse([ncx - nr, ncy - nr, ncx + nr, ncy + nr], fill=UNICEF_CYAN)
    num_text = str(i + 1)
    bbox_n = draw.textbbox((0, 0), num_text, font=f_fnum)
    nw = bbox_n[2] - bbox_n[0]
    draw.text((ncx - nw // 2, ncy - 13), num_text, font=f_fnum, fill=WHITE)

    # Title
    draw.text((fx + 80, fy + 28), title, font=f_ftitle, fill=DEEP_NAVY)

    # Description
    lines = desc.split("\n")
    for j, line in enumerate(lines):
        draw.text((fx + 80, fy + 78 + j * 35), line, font=f_fdesc, fill=CHARCOAL)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5: CALL TO ACTION
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cta_y = focus_y + focus_h
cta_h = H - cta_y
draw_vgradient(draw, (0, cta_y, W, H), WARM_AMBER, SOFT_ORANGE)

# SDG 4 reference
f_sdg = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 38)
f_sdg_sub = make_font(FONT_REG, 30)
draw_centered(draw, "ALIGNED WITH SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOAL 4", cta_y + 50, f_sdg, DEEP_NAVY)
draw_centered(draw, "Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education for all", cta_y + 100, f_sdg_sub, (80, 40, 0))

# Divider
draw.rectangle([W // 2 - 250, cta_y + 155, W // 2 + 250, cta_y + 160], fill=DEEP_AMBER)

# CTA headline
f_cta = make_font(FONT_LIB_B, 78)
draw_centered(draw, "EVERY CHILD WHO MISSES", cta_y + 200, f_cta, DEEP_NAVY)
draw_centered(draw, "OUT ON EDUCATION IS A", cta_y + 295, f_cta, DEEP_NAVY)
draw_centered(draw, "MISSED OPPORTUNITY", cta_y + 390, f_cta, WHITE)

# Supporting text
f_cta_body = make_font(FONT_REG, 36)
draw_centered(draw, "Investing in education means investing in peace,", cta_y + 530, f_cta_body, (80, 40, 0))
draw_centered(draw, "innovation, and sustainable development.", cta_y + 578, f_cta_body, (80, 40, 0))

# Final rallying line
f_cta_final = make_font(FONT_BOLD, 48)
draw_centered(draw, "Together we can ensure that no child is left behind.", cta_y + 680, f_cta_final, DEEP_NAVY)

# Bottom bar
draw.rectangle([0, H - 50, W, H], fill=DEEP_NAVY)
f_footer = make_font(FONT_REG, 24)
draw_centered(draw, "Source: UNICEF Education Programme  |  unicef.org/education", H - 40, f_footer, LIGHT_CYAN)

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}px, A1 portrait @ 150 DPI")
